extracted.stage: Estate administration, IHT due before assets can be realised
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of an estate of about £4,172,500 (commercial property and a farm) asks whether a facility of £809,000 can be considered to meet the inheritance tax bill.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry, which we have received and logged. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction in which the estate is being administered, the date of the relevant IHT payment deadline, and whether a grant of probate has been obtained or applied for. It would also help to have a breakdown of the estate assets and any existing charges or liabilities over the commercial property and farm, together with details of the executors. Once we have those documents a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you.
